description:
[This is a non AI, human made channel - just like ye good olde days] An armoured knight on a lumbering steed, toiling serfs, tied to the lands of their lord, cloistered monks and nuns, lost in prayer, and don’t forget the scenery: high-walled castles, great gothic churches, and farms, farms, and more farms. Join us here at MedievalMadness as we do our weekly deep dives into all things Medieval!
